rows.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
rows.comment: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

rows.name: Cam Ward
rows.comment: Ward completed 26 of 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He added seven rushing attempts for 41 yards, lost a fumble, ran in a two-point conversion and threw a successful two-point conversion.

rows.name: Tony Pollard
rows.comment: Pollard rushed 21 times for 117 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

rows.name: Peter Skoronski
rows.comment: Skoronski (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: JC Latham
rows.comment: Latham (finger) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: James Williams Sr.
rows.comment: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: Marcus Harris
rows.comment: Harris (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bengals.

rows.name: John Franklin-Myers
rows.comment: Franklin-Myers (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Thomas Morstead
rows.comment: The Titans elevated Morstead from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

rows.name: Dorian Mausi
rows.comment: Mausi (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Jonah Laulu
rows.comment: The Titans claimed Laulu off waivers from the Raiders on Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rows.name: Amani Hooker
rows.comment: Hooker posted five tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland.

rows.name: Jaden Bradley
rows.comment: The Commanders elevated Bradley from their practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup versus the Rams.

rows.name: Dyami Brown
rows.comment: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

rows.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
rows.comment: The Commanders activated Newton (pectoral) from injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

rows.name: Treylon Burks
rows.comment: Burks (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.

rows.name: Daron Payne
rows.comment: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

rows.name: Jeremy McNichols
rows.comment: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

rows.name: Javon Kinlaw
rows.comment: Kinlaw underwent season-ending surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Robert Henry Jr.
rows.comment: The Commanders claimed Henry off waivers from the Seahawks on Tuesday.

rows.name: Drew Stevens
rows.comment: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.comment: Okonkwo tallied two catches (on four targets) for 32 yards during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.comment: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

rows.name: Austin Ekeler
rows.comment: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

rows.name: Rachaad White
rows.comment: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

rows.name: Stefon Diggs
rows.comment: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels
rows.comment: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

rows.name: Charles Omenihu
rows.comment: Omenihu (groin/ankle) is active for Sunday night's contest against the Eagles.

rows.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
rows.comment: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback Sunday night against the Eagles.

rows.name: Terry McLaurin
rows.comment: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
